Nigel Farage Faces Scrutiny Over Campaign Donations

Nigel Farage, leader of Reform UK, is facing scrutiny and is expected to be questioned regarding his political campaign's donations. Senior aides to Farage reportedly discussed strategies to circumvent electoral laws concerning foreign donations. This situation has led to turmoil for Farage as he attempts to manage the growing scandal surrounding these contributions. Andy Burnham, a UK politician, is noted as having gained some political distance amidst this controversy.
